cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no current decision on the transport compression codec is recorded, and it names no codec.

Muninn has no decision or rule on compression. Its catalog lists decisions on https, certificate verification, rustls, argon2id and the LRU cache, but none on compression. `muninn why` reported "insufficient". The only related record is an earlier session where the user typed just "gzip". That is an unverified, trust-1 episode with no context, so I didn't treat it as a decision.

The Muninn heartbeat is also RED: 20 hook runs started and never finished. If a compression decision was made and not captured, that could be why. Check `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
